items.title: Anthropic vs. OpenAI: Competition heats up with release of new AI models
items.summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) unveiled its new Claude Opus 5.5 on Tuesday, the developer's latest AI model promising faster performance and lower costs for enterprise customers. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley examines the tightening AI competition between Anthropic and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT), which also just released its new GPT-6 Sol and Luna models.

items.title: The Magnificent 7 are back: Meta’s AI bet leads the charge
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and host of Sozzi Unleashed, Brian Sozzi, tees up the stories making waves across the markets. The Magnificent 7 are back in focus as megacap tech stocks help push markets higher, with Meta (META) leading the charge after its new Muse AI agent gained momentum and climbed to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store.

items.title: How Far Could CRM Stock Swing In A Year?
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) stock trades at about $236 after returning about 58% over three months. Its options now price a range over roughly a year that runs from about $152 to about $368. The bottom of that band is a price the stock has already traded through within the past year, and the market is pricing the band a little calmer than the stock has actually moved.
